name: Elvis Presley

name: Sylvia Plath

name: Stephen Hawking

name: Louis Pasteur

name: Henri Poincaré

name: Henri Matisse

name: Paul Cézanne

name: Paul Gauguin

name: Pierre-Auguste Renoir

name: Marcel Proust

name: Albert Camus

name: Victor Hugo

name: George Sand

name: Alexandre Dumas

name: Jean-Paul Sartre
bio: Existentialist philosopher and writer who declined the Nobel Prize in Literature.

name: Simone de Beauvoir

name: Michel Foucault

name: Charles de Gaulle

name: John F. Kennedy

name: Georges Clemenceau

name: Theodore Roosevelt
bio: 26th U.S. president, trust-buster, conservationist, and Rough Rider.

name: Martin Luther King Jr.

name: Anthony Hopkins

name: Bob Marley

name: Stevie Wonder

name: Johnny Cash

name: Paul McCartney

name: Steven Spielberg

name: Andy Warhol

name: John Travolta

name: Sophia Loren
